Listopia > Existentialism
Existentialism is a philosophical movement that concentrates its attention on human existence and aims to solve the concerns of today's man. One of the most appreciable features of existentialism is pessimism, sorrow, and anxiety in the face of a world that offers only suffering, a world that shows life as an individually creative path of making oneself, despite daily collective misery.
